race.comment: TOWER OF TUSCANY (2) speared across from the wide alley and gave backers a bold sight in front first-up over the mile  but just lacked a fitness edge late. Better for that and is drawn much kinder with Milnes sticking. Can get the job done this time. TOTTORI (8) will relish a solid tempo and if Toeroek can have him settling a pair or two closer he will take a power of stopping late. NAVY ROK (3) made a mess of his maiden rivals last start when finally getting off the mark. Suspect they will be handy again from he inside alley and be in this for a very long way. Can make it two on the trot. MAXILDO (1) bounced straight to the front here last start and never gave them a sniff when leading all the way. The subsequent form has already produce 3 winners in 3 weeks. Carries more weight but is drawn favourably and should give another great sight. CROWN MINT (7) is another that will be hoping they overdo it early doors so he can launch late.
